If Payment Due Date (‘PDD’) of a Credit Card account is 31st March 2021, and ’Minimum Amount Due
(‘MAD’) is not received before this date then after the due date, the account will be mentioned as SMA-0.
If the account continues to remain overdue beyond 30 days from PDD i.e., beyond 30th April 2021 then this
account shall get tagged as SMA-1.
Similarly, if the account continues to remain overdue, beyond 60 days from PDD i.e., beyond 30th May
2021 then this account shall get tagged as SMA-2.
